clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country to buy an apple orchard in March 1952, within the next year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and by September June had joined the church choir and her letters thinned out. The shifts pile up from May 1952 through September 1953, with Walter's conflict with Glen and his cutoff from Harlan falling in the months after the move.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily by June, he and Glen blaming each other, Glen and Marian taking over the family's finances and Glen's talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora wetting the bed again by April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found that May, and Walter stopped drinking by October and took work pruning trees. The shifts in Glen's functioning and his move to overfunctioning alongside Walter's symptom, and the children's symptoms, cluster around the months from the frost through the autumn.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job lost when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices, Nora stopping eating and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distant from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years, and by June 1976 Nora was eating again and made the track team. The family's reactions pile up through the latter half of 1975, with Glen's functioning down and Marian's overfunctioning, alongside Nora's symptom and distance, settling as Glen found work driving a delivery truck in March.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990 after selling her farm: clashes between Nora and Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and keeping out of the rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows most nights between Nora and Hollis, and by August 1991 the eczema cleared over the summer. The conflict and shifts in Nora's relationship move and symptom pile up through 1990 and into early 1991, settling after Wilma took a flat in town in June.
